name: Solivella (Spain)
description: Dark green field charged with a yellow sun with a face at the upper hoist and a yellow olive tree fruited black at the lower fly.
history: The official flag of Solivella is oblong, of proportions two high by three long, dark green, with the yellow sun with a face of the arms, of diameter 13/30 of the height of the cloth, placed at 1/15 of the height from the upper edge and 2/45 of the length from the hoist, and with the yellow olive tree fruited black of the arms, of height 13/30 of the cloth and width 14/45 of its length, placed at 1/15 of the height from the lower edge and 2/45 of the length from the fly.

features.role: sun with a face at the upper hoist
olive tree at the lower fly
